items.title: The Secret to Building Your Ideas Without Code
items.summary: In episode 1009 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Steve Mock, Investor at Blumberg Capital about how AI is transforming professional fulfillment, sharing a story from aisavedme.org where a designer used AI to build his own ideas without coding. This newfound ability led to a significant increase in his creative spark and professional happiness, demonstrating AI's power to empower individuals by handling undesirable tasks.

items.title: ChatGPT Work: Everything You Need to Know to Get Started!
items.summary:
This video takes you from "why does my ChatGPT look different??" to "Oh my gosh this is the best update ever and I can't wait to start using it!". In it, Igor breaks down the new ChatGPT Work and gives you a quick-start tutorial on how to use it. This is the first in a series teaching you how to use ChatGPT Work, so subscribe if you enjoy this episode and want to see the next one! Enjoy :)


Discover 10 practical ways to use ChatGPT Work to save time, organize your workload, and move projects forward faster: https://learn.aiadvantage.com/free-pdf


Prompts:
I'm Dave, and I own Dave's Landscaping, a local, family-run lawn care and landscaping business. I serve residential customers in the area, and I've built this on being reliable and doing quality work. I'm not a coder, so this is new territory for me.
Here's what I need: build me a website for my business. Include a homepage with a headline and hero section, a services section listing mowing, trimming, leaf removal, and seasonal yard cleanup, an about section, a photo gallery for before-and-after photos, and a contact section with a quote-request form.
Here's what good looks like: clean, professional, and simple. Use a green, outdoorsy color scheme that reflects what I do. Make it so a customer can find what they need in seconds. I want to end up with a live website I can send to customers — I don't want to touch any code.

items.title: Why TikTok Beats TV, But Not In India - Santosh Nair Explains, After Tracking $3.8B In Ad Spend
items.summary:
TikTok may appear to deliver stronger short-term ROI than television, but Santosh Nair explains why marketing measurement needs to account for the entire consumer journey.

In this episode of Simulated Reality, Santosh Nair, Senior Vice President & Co-Head of Analytic Edge, explains how companies measure advertising effectiveness across television, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. He discusses Analytic Edge's acquisition by C5i, the challenge of measuring approximately $3.8 billion in advertising spend, marketing mix modelling, full-funnel measurement, the limits of last-click attribution, and how AI and agentic systems could reshape marketing analytics. Santosh also shares lessons from building Analytic Edge, the importance of transparent glass-box models, why short-term ROI can mislead organisations, and why human judgement will remain essential in the final marketing decision.
